lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance blobs are arranged in a semi-regular grid of approximately four to five horizontal rows along the mid-flank, with increased spatial separation toward the posterior peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated intensity intersect horizontal spot clusters, creating anchor nodes particularly prominent in the mid-section posterior to the pectoral fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, manifesting as sharp horizontal boundaries with high-luminance upper edges and lower-luminance shadow troughs.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs, with approximately 8-12 distinct spots visible against the darker fin substrate.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense cluster of small, high-intensity spots is visible on the anterior leading edge of the pectoral fin and the ventral portion of the head.
